items.title: 4.3.1 Combining Stacks and Queues to Evaluate Expressions (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of combining stacks and queues (PDF 118).

blocks.text: Stacks aur queues hisabi expressions hal karne ke taqatwar auzaar hain, khaas taur par jab expression mein pecheeda operations hon. In dono ko mila kar hum operations ki tarteeb, brackets (parentheses) aur expression ka sahi jawab achhi tarah sambhal sakte hain.

blocks.prompt: Infix ko postfix mein badalte waqt stack kya rakh sakta hai aur queue kya?
blocks.explanation: Stack operators aur brackets rakhta hai; output tokens ek queue mein rakhe ja sakte hain, jinhein postfix hal karte waqt aage se parha jaye. (Yeh jora aam ilm hai; kitab is ki hal shuda misal nahi deti.)

items: Stacks aur queues mil kar expressions mein operators ki tarteeb aur brackets sambhalte hain.
